scholarships.description: All applicants for this scholarship must be from Myanmar. Applicants are also subjected to an interview to assess their eligibility for the scholarship. To qualify, students must meet the following criteria: Achieved High School Matriculation Grade 12 overall score 440 and above or GED overall score
